## Location

Which document or page is this about? (e.g. `README.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, a code comment, generated API docs)

Link or file path:

## Issue Type

- [ ] Missing documentation
- [ ] Incorrect / outdated information
- [ ] Unclear explanation
- [ ] Broken link
- [ ] Typo / grammar
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Description

Describe what's wrong or missing. If something is unclear, explain what confused you — that's genuinely useful signal, not a nitpick.

## Suggested Improvement

If you have a specific rewrite or addition in mind, share it here. Not required — even "this section needs more detail" is helpful.

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues to make sure this isn't a duplicate
